svg.text: Pin refill: batch work, ordered publication
#27237 • Fix the batch endpoint before metadata I/O; keep backend execution independent
Select a bounded queued prefix [v1, v2, v3]; endpoint = v3.
Prune superseded A / B before metadata: keep C.
Load metadata -> recheck policy + vnodes -> submit survivors once.
Shared I/O budget; original token guards result publication.
Success, failure or timeout: only v3 is a publication endpoint.
Version queue: settled FIFO prefix through an endpoint
When both backend conditions permit, publish through v3.
Advance read versions, then retire old membership (A / B).
The next Pin batch can start before publication. Capacity rejection does not wait for GC.
